supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:51 UTC, WS-MLOPEZ-01, attributed in the proxy log to maria.lopez, successfully retrieved https://raw.githubusercontent.com/harbor-dental-it/tools/main/u.ps1. The proxy record shows user agent "-"; the associated connection record reports 1,852 response bytes.

A second connection to raw.githubusercontent.com followed immediately, but its record shows only a CONNECT tunnel and connection byte counts; the supplied evidence does not establish what content, if any, was retrieved through it.
At 13:37 UTC, the workstation accessed Google Drive, including the My Drive page. Google Drive is not among the services approved in the supplied environment context.

At 13:40:53 UTC, WS-MLOPEZ-01 established an SMB connection to DC-HD-01. The DC logged a network logon for the workstation account WS-MLOPEZ-01$; the records do not identify the share or files accessed.
The supplied records do not show whether the GitHub script retrieval, the SMB connection, and the reported brief PowerShell window were causally related.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include the contents or hash of u.ps1, or evidence that it was saved or executed.
No supplied record identifies a PowerShell process or command line around the reported time; this does not establish that no such process occurred.
The SMB records do not identify the accessed share, requested files, or the process that initiated the connection.
Proxy records establish destinations and some requests or byte counts, but do not by themselves establish user intent or the contents of all tunneled traffic.
claims_not_established: That a PowerShell window appeared at approximately 13:40 UTC or that PowerShell executed u.ps1.
That u.ps1 or any other retrieved content was malicious.
That the SMB connection to DC-HD-01 accessed sensitive data or performed an administrative action.
That Google Drive was used to upload or download organizational data.
That the GitHub repository or script was unauthorized or compromised.
additional_evidence_needed: Endpoint process and command-line telemetry for WS-MLOPEZ-01 around 13:39–13:42 UTC, including PowerShell operational/script-block logs and parent-child process details.
File-system, browser download/history, and EDR evidence to determine whether u.ps1 was downloaded, where it was stored, and whether it was executed; obtain its content and hash if available.
Complete proxy request/response and inspection records for both raw.githubusercontent.com connections and the Google Drive session.
DC SMB auditing or equivalent telemetry identifying the share and objects accessed during the 13:40:53 UTC connection.
Corroboration from maria.lopez or the help desk about the reported window and whether the GitHub script and Google Drive access were expected.
